payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
index 477aae247..64d941681 100644
--- a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
+++ b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
@@ -231,6 +231,11 @@ def get_object_members(subject: Any, objpath: List[str], attrgetter: Callable,
             name = unmangle(cls, name)
             if name and name not in members:
                 members[name] = Attribute(name, i == 0, INSTANCEATTR)
+            elif name and name in members and not members[name].directly_defined:
+                # If the member was already found as an annotation-only member
+                # in a parent class, update it to reflect the most specific class
+                # where it's directly defined
+                members[name] = Attribute(name, i == 0, INSTANCEATTR)
 
     if analyzer:
         # append instance attributes (cf. self.attr1) if analyzer knows

diff --git a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
index 477aae247..152e020f5 100644
--- a/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
+++ b/sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py
@@ -298,7 +298,8 @@ def get_class_members(subject: Any, objpath: List[str], attrgetter: Callable
             for name in getannotations(cls):
                 name = unmangle(cls, name)
                 if name and name not in members:
-                    members[name] = ObjectMember(name, INSTANCEATTR, class_=cls)
+                    members[name] = ObjectMember(name, INSTANCEATTR, class_=cls,
+                                                 docstring=getdoc(cls, name))
 
             # append instance attributes (cf. self.attr1) if analyzer knows
             try:
